The early persistent silicone/emollient deposit establishes neutral_non_volatile; late guar r14 is recorded without promotion based solely on the vacuous marker. Water-soluble-only fails on r4/r5/r7/r8. Permanent cationic would require confirming guar r14 as architecture; a vacuous marker cannot confer it. Late polymeric guar may increase persistence, but its architectural role is unresolved; targeted review required. Cetrimonium is permanently charged but monomeric and surfactant-removable: below polymeric/silicone quats; mechanism class is not a duration. The complete formula declares conditioning and emulsion architecture without a fixative hold route. None is a researched absence. Incidental or meaningful hold needs an L5 observation absent here.
